title: A longitudinal Bayesian framework for estimating causal dose-response relationships
abstractText: Abstract Existing causal methods for time-varying exposure and time-varying confounding focus on estimating the average causal effect of a time-varying binary treatment on an end-of-study outcome, offering limited tools for characterizing marginal causal dose-response relationships under continuous exposures. We propose a scalable, nonparametric Bayesian framework for estimating marginal longitudinal causal dose-response functions with repeated outcome measurements. Our approach targets the average potential outcome at any fixed dose level and accommodates time-varying confounding through the generalized propensity score. The proposed approach embeds a Dirichlet process specification within a generalized estimating equations structure, capturing temporal correlation while making minimal assumptions about the functional form of the continuous exposure. We apply the proposed methods to monthly metro ridership and COVID-19 case data from major international cities, identifying causal relationships and the dose-response patterns between higher ridership and increased case counts.

title: TELEREHABILITATION: OPTIMIZING PATIENT OUTCOMES AND ACCESSIBILITY IN POST-STROKE RECOVERY
abstractText: Background: Stroke remains a leading cause of long-term disability worldwide, necessitating intensive and prolonged rehabilitation interventions. Aim: Telerehabilitation has emerged as a promising alternative to traditional in-person therapy, offering potential solutions to barriers in accessibility, cost, and continuity of care. Methods: to examine the effectiveness, accessibility, implementation challenges, and patient outcomes associated with telerehabilitation for post-stroke recovery, reveals that telerehabilitation demonstrates comparable or superior outcomes to conventional therapy across multiple domains including motor function, activities of daily living, quality of life, and patient satisfaction. Evidence indicates that synchronous video-based interventions, combined with asynchronous monitoring and virtual reality applications, yield significant improvements in functional recovery. Results: shows standardized mean differences ranging from 0.42-0.68 for upper extremity function, no significant difference in ADL outcomes (SMD -0.00, 95% CI -0.15 to 0.15), and improvements in balance outcomes. Cost analyses demonstrate savings of $654-$867 per participant compared to conventional care. Accessibility benefits include 78% reduction in travel burden and enhanced service delivery to rural populations where rehabilitation access is 45% lower than urban areas. However, implementation challenges persist, including technology barriers affecting 23-35% of older adults, digital literacy gaps, and regulatory uncertainties. Conclusion: This review synthesizes current evidence with detailed results tables, identifies best practices for telerehabilitation delivery, and proposes frameworks for optimizing patient outcomes while addressing existing barriers to widespread adoption.

title: Environmental enrichment affects growth and behaviour differently in head-started critically endangered freshwater turtles
abstractText: Abstract Freshwater chelonians face severe extinction risk, and head-starting programs increasingly rely on captive rearing to offset poor recruitment. However, evaluating success by growth and release numbers overlooks welfare and post-release competence. We assessed head-started Critically Endangered Batagur dhongoka and Batagur kachuga under five enrichment treatments, combining growth data with individual-level behavioural scans and 24-hour group activity budgets over 367 days. Final body mass was highest under mixed enrichment (141.1 g) and lowest under no-enrichment (108.1 g). B. kachuga were heavier than B. dhongoka under all treatments. Enrichment-related behaviour was highest under natural enrichment (52.5%) and lowest under no-enrichment (11.9%), while stress-related behaviour was lowest under seminatural enrichment (1.6%) and highest under no-enrichment (10.7%). Mixed enrichment produced the highest basking response and most balanced group activity budget; natural enrichment the highest shelter-use response. Integrating growth and behaviour at the same month × species × treatment scale, natural enrichment ranked first, mixed second, and no-enrichment last. Environmental enrichment shapes growth and behaviour differently; growth and behavioural metrics should therefore be treated as complementary rather than interchangeable indicators of captive-rearing success. Each species-treatment combination comprised a single chamber, with individual-level behaviour from one marked animal; results are therefore descriptive rather than independently replicated.

Hardware-Assisted Intrusion Detection System for Automotive Embedded ECUs
abstractText: Modern automotive systems progressively rely on Electronic Control Units (ECUs) to take control of vital vehicle functionality and are heavily interlinked on in-vehicle networks, e.g. the Controller Area Network (CAN). With the increased vehicle sophistication into a complex cyber-physical system, the car is more exposed to cyber-related attacks such as message injection, spoofing, and denial-of-service (DoS) attacks that have the potential to affect safety and performance. Implementations of Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) using software, can be not very effective when it comes to real-time detection, because of the computational overhead imposed by them and the shared CPU usage. The paper proposes a new hardware-assisted intrusion detection system (H-IDS) designed to work on the automotive platforms and embedded devices (ECUs) in particular but is focused on the low-latency and real-time nature of the system and its capability to deploy on resource-constrained devices. The described architecture uses a light on-chip co-processor in the ECU as a special security engine to observe CAN traffic and observe abnormal behavior based on temporal and statistical characteristics. The H-IDS performs detection tasks on a separate processor-offloading payload so it does not interfere with other processes or even stop when the vehicle does not perform its tasks. This was implemented on an ECU platform based on the ARM Cortex-R5 in a hardware prototyping system with FPGA and then tested in a range of simulated attack conditions. The input of the experiment shows that there is a significant reduction in the detection latency that the H-IDS displays an average latency of 14 microseconds that is much faster than software-only solutions. Also, the design has less than 2 percent CPU overhead and its power and memory requirements fit squarely within the power and memory budget of most automotive embedded systems. The provided proposed H-IDS is aligned with ISO/SAE 21434 standards of cybersecurity, and it is scalable to be deployed on various heterogeneous ECU systems. Through the increased detection responsiveness and negligible resource consumption, the work is a step towards realistic hardware-enforced security measures, which can be incorporated in the next generation of automotive architectures to guarantee resilient and trustful in-vehicle networks.

title: Integrasi Workflow Jurnal Keuangan Berbasis Website Menggunakan Analisis Pieces dan Metode Agile Scrum
abstractText: Hospital financial governance depends on how well the journal approval workflow is recorded and traced. The desktop-based Financial Information System (SIMKEU) used by the hospital under study supports journal entry and posting, but examination, approval, and endorsement are still handled through physical documents outside the system, so access is inflexible and the process status is not digitally documented. This study analyses the running system and develops a website-based financial information system that integrates the tiered journal workflow. Data were collected through observation, interviews with finance staff, the assistant finance manager, and the finance manager, and a literature study. The running system was analysed using the PIECES framework, while development applied the Agile approach with Scrum over approximately three months, with the researcher acting as a single full-stack developer. The system was built on CodeIgniter 3 and combines the existing Oracle database as the journal data source with MySQL as the workflow, access-rights, and activity-log store, so the legacy schema remains unchanged. Alpha testing of twenty function groups using black-box testing produced conforming results, and User Acceptance Testing with five respondents produced an acceptance rate of 76.89% in the Good category.

title: A Conceptual Model of Digital Ecosystem-Based Circular Economy for Craft Industries Utilizing Renewable Natural Resources
abstractText: The handicraft sector utilizing renewable natural resources plays a pivotal role in rural economic development and cultural preservation. However, conventional linear production models face severe market frictions, including upstream resource depletion, information asymmetry, and unaccounted ecological externalities. Grounded in environmental resource economics, microeconomic value theory, and digital platform architecture, this study proposes a conceptual framework that integrates circular economy principles into a digital ecosystem. Using an integrative conceptual synthesis methodology, this study models the structural interactions among four core dimensions: closed-loop input stewardship, smart platform verification, consumer willingness-to-pay internalisation, and community-level economic governance. The model introduces four key theoretical propositions explaining how distributed digital ledgers and eco-labeling mitigate moral hazard, transform positive environmental externalities into producer surplus, and optimize resource renewal rates. Ultimately, the conceptual architecture demonstrates that digital enablement does not merely digitize commercial transactions, but recalibrates resource governance, fostering regenerative rural craft clusters and long-term socio-ecological sustainability.

title: Pemutakhiran Indeks Desa sebagai Upaya Mendukung Perencanaan Pembangunan Gampong Layung
abstractText: Data desa yang akurat dan termutakhirkan merupakan dasar utama dalam penyusunan perencanaan pembangunan gampong, termasuk dalam penilaian tingkat kemajuan dan kemandirian desa melalui Indeks Desa. Data kependudukan, kondisi masyarakat, dan profil Gampong Layung, Kecamatan Bubon, Kabupaten Aceh Barat, belum sepenuhnya mencerminkan kondisi terkini sehingga diperlukan proses pemutakhiran. Kegiatan pengabdian ini bertujuan memutakhirkan data Indeks Desa Gampong Layung sekaligus menyiapkan data tersebut sebagai bahan pertimbangan dalam perencanaan pembangunan gampong. Kegiatan dilaksanakan pada 2–11 Agustus 2026 oleh mahasiswa Kuliah Kerja Nyata (KKN) bersama kepala gampong dan perangkat gampong dengan pendekatan partisipatif, melalui tahapan koordinasi awal, pengumpulan data, pengecekan dan observasi lapangan, verifikasi bersama perangkat gampong, entri dan rekapitulasi, serta penyerahan hasil pemutakhiran kepada pemerintah gampong. Hasil kegiatan berupa data Indeks Desa yang telah diperbarui dan lebih sesuai dengan kondisi aktual gampong, meliputi data kependudukan, profil gampong, kondisi sosial masyarakat, serta data pendukung lainnya yang diperoleh melalui pendataan dan verifikasi bersama perangkat gampong. Kendala utama berupa keterbatasan waktu pelaksanaan dan belum lengkapnya data pembanding diatasi melalui koordinasi yang lebih intensif serta pemanfaatan dokumen dan data sekunder yang tersedia di kantor gampong. Data hasil pemutakhiran ini memberikan manfaat berupa tersedianya informasi yang lebih relevan bagi perangkat gampong dalam mengidentifikasi kebutuhan masyarakat dan menyusun program pembangunan. Kegiatan ini menegaskan bahwa pemutakhiran data desa perlu dilanjutkan secara berkala oleh pemerintah gampong agar dokumen perencanaan pembangunan tetap berbasis data yang mutakhir.

title: An adaptive federated deep learning approach for efficient DDoS detection in IoT edge networks
abstractText: Abstract The rapid growth of the Internet of Things (IoT) has expanded the attack surface of modern networks, motivating the need for accurate detection of DDoS and botnet activity in resource-constrained settings. Centralised intrusion detection systems (IDS) face privacy, scalability, and heterogeneity challenges that limit their suitability for IoT. This study suggests a Federated Learning-based Intrusion Detection System (FL-IDS) for IoT edge networks in order to get around these restrictions. Each client trains a hybrid CNN-LSTM model locally, and a central server aggregates client updates with Federated Averaging (FedAvg). An adaptive global decision-threshold optimisation is used post-training to the pooled predictions of the global model on the held-out test partition in order to address class imbalance. The system is evaluated on the N-BaIoT benchmark together with preliminary validation on a recent public healthcare IoT dataset, with the nine N-BaIoT devices treated as independent federated clients during the primary federated evaluation. The global model achieves an accuracy of 0.9238, precision of 0.9265, recall of 0.9963, F1-score of 0.9601, ROC-AUC of 0.8133, and PR-AUC of 0.969 at the optimal operating point $$\tau = 0.15$$ . SHAP-based post-hoc analysis identifies the traffic features that most influence model decisions.

Fabrication of superhydrophobic and superoleophilic copper oxide nanostructures without organic modifiers for oil–water separation
abstractText: Abstract Superhydrophobic and superoleophilic hierarchical urchin-like copper oxide powders were synthesized by a facile one-step method without the use of low-surface-energy modifiers. The selective wettability of the powders toward water and oil makes them suitable for oil adsorption from oil-in-water emulsions. In addition, the hierarchical CuO structures were grown in situ on a stainless-steel mesh, which was used for the separation of heavy oil–water mixtures. The synergistic combination of micro-/nanoscale roughness and a reduction in the polar component of surface free energy through hydroxylation of the copper oxide surface likely leads to a significant decrease in wettability and the development of superhydrophobic and superoleophilic properties, as evidenced by a static water contact angle of 161.1° ± 2° and an oil contact angle of 0°, measured on the CuO-coated mesh surface. The superhydrophobic copper oxide particles demonstrated a high oil adsorption selectivity greater than 19. The immiscible chloroform/water mixture was separated via a simple filtration method using a superhydrophobic/superoleophilic copper oxide–coated mesh filter, achieving a separation efficiency of approximately 98% and a chloroform permeation flux of about 7300 L m⁻² h⁻¹. In addition, copper oxide powder showed promising potential as a selective oil adsorbent for the treatment of oil-in-water emulsions and the cleanup of oil spills when used in the form of sorbent booms or pillows.

title: Acute anterior uveitis following eyebrow hair removal with 1064-nm Nd: YAG laser: two case reports
abstractText: Abstract Background Laser hair removal using Alexandrite (755 nm) and Nd: YAG (1064 nm) lasers is a widely performed cosmetic procedure. dual-wavelength systems, such as the Candela GentleMax Pro, combine both wavelengths to improve treatment efficacy and versatility. Although generally considered safe, ocular complications may occur during periorbital applications, particularly when appropriate eye protection is not used. While previous reports have described anterior uveitis following Alexandrite laser exposure, ocular complications specifically attributable to the Nd: YAG wavelength remain poorly documented. Case presentation We report two cases of acute unilateral anterior uveitis following eyebrow hair removal using the Nd: YAG (1064 nm) channel of the Candela GentleMax Pro device in two healthy female patients aged 24 and 32 years. Both patients underwent laser epilation without protective eyewear and developed pain, photophobia, and blurred vision within 6 to 24 h of the procedure. Ophthalmologic examination revealed ciliary injection and anterior chamber inflammation in the affected eyes, while the contralateral eyes were normal. Other causes of unilateral anterior uveitis, including herpetic etiology, were clinically excluded. Both patients were treated with topical prednisolone acetate and tropicamide eye drops, resulting in rapid clinical improvement and complete resolution within days to few weeks without residual complications. Conclusions These cases highlight a potentially underrecognized ocular complication associated with Nd: YAG laser systemduring periorbital hair removal procedures. The findings emphasize the importance of strict ocular safety measures, including the use of wavelength-specific protective eyewear or corneal shields, as well as adequate operator training, to minimize the risk of sight-threatening complications.

OPTIMASI TEGANGAN DAN WAKTU REAKSI PROSES ELEKTRO-FENTON DALAM PENGOLAHAN LIMBAH CAIR INDUSTRI GULA RAFINASI
abstractText: Industri gula rafinasi menghasilkan limbah cair dengan kandungan bahan organik tinggi yang ditunjukkan oleh nilai Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD), terutama akibat keberadaan senyawa refraktori seperti melanoidin yang sulit didegradasi melalui pengolahan biologis konvensional. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menentukan kondisi operasi optimum berdasarkan variasi tegangan listrik dan waktu reaksi. Proses elektro-Fenton dilakukan menggunakan variasi tegangan 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, dan 9 V dengan waktu reaksi 45, 60, dan 75 menit. Efektivitas proses dianalisis berdasarkan persentase penyisihan COD setelah perlakuan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa peningkatan tegangan dan waktu reaksi umumnya meningkatkan efisiensi penyisihan COD hingga mencapai kondisi optimum. Efisiensi penyisihan tertinggi sebesar 97% diperoleh pada tegangan 8 V dan waktu reaksi 75 menit. Sebaliknya, pada tegangan 9 V efisiensi penyisihan menurun akibat terjadinya reaksi samping yang mengurangi ketersediaan radikal hidroksil (•OH) sebagai oksidator utama. Hasil ini menunjukkan bahwa pembentukan radikal hidroksil dipengaruhi secara signifikan oleh kondisi operasi sistem elektro-Fenton. Dibandingkan dengan beberapa penelitian terdahulu, proses elektro-Fenton pada penelitian ini menunjukkan efisiensi penyisihan COD yang lebih tinggi, sehingga berpotensi diterapkan sebagai teknologi pengolahan lanjutan untuk limbah cair industri gula rafinasi yang mengandung senyawa organik kompleks dan sukar terdegradasi. Dengan demikian, kombinasi tegangan listrik dan waktu reaksi yang tepat menjadi faktor penting dalam mengoptimalkan kinerja proses elektro-Fenton.

title: Coronas telescópicas en prótesis removible: elaboración, materiales y resultados clínicos
abstractText: Objetivo: analizar la evidencia sobre la elaboración en el laboratorio, los materiales y los resultados clínicos de las coronas telescópicas en prótesis removible. Métodos: revisión de la literatura con síntesis narrativa en PubMed, SciELO y DOAJ; se seleccionaron 15 documentos. Resultados: la corona primaria se cementa sobre el pilar y la secundaria forma parte del armazón removible. La supervivencia de los pilares telescópicos fue del 82,5 % al 96,5 % entre 3,4 y 6 años, y la de las prótesis dentosoportadas, del 66,7 % al 98,6 % entre 6 y 10 años. Las coronas secundarias electroformadas y las de PEEK o PEKK mantuvieron mejor la retención que las coladas de cromo-cobalto. Conclusión: las coronas telescópicas son una opción predecible; su éxito depende de la precisión del laboratorio, de la combinación de materiales y del control periódico.

title: Cognitive disorganization in help-seeking youth: a transdiagnostic developmental formulation perspective
abstractText: Abstract Cognitive disorganization in help-seeking youth can involve difficulties with attention, task sequencing, language access, or discourse organization alongside unusual experiences and functional decline. This Perspective proposes a transdiagnostic developmental approach to clinical formulation using four complementary questions: what is the young person’s developmental baseline; which functions vary within the person across load, context, and time; what is happening in the environment and how is threat interpreted; and do established clinical-risk indicators require formal assessment or referral? The questions address different assessment tasks, may be considered together, and constitute a proposed clinical heuristic. Assessment of genuine environmental harm, safeguarding needs, and urgent medical or psychiatric risk takes precedence over explanatory interpretation. The synthesis distinguishes direct evidence from adjacent findings and clinical hypotheses. Acute-stress research supports effects on specified executive outcomes under studied conditions; extrapolation to discourse organization, threat meanings, or reality testing in help-seeking youth remains insufficiently supported. Stress sensitivity is therefore a domain-specific formulation hypothesis to test, not an established property of the presentation. The proposed contribution is to organize established assessment domains around observable difficulties and documented uncertainty. Prospective studies should measure domains separately and assess reliability, incremental clinical value, and safety against explicit alternative explanations and falsification criteria.

Topological Chemistry of PtPb4 Surfaces under Reconstruction and Hydrogen Adsorption
abstractText: Abstract Topological materials have recently been proposed as promising catalysts owing to the presence of robust topological surface states (TSSs). However, the microscopic role of TSSs in catalytic processes remains elusive. In particular, it is unclear how TSSs can simultaneously remain robust against chemical perturbations while actively participating in surface reactions. Here, we address this question through a combined study of the bulk topology, surface structure, and hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) behavior of PtPb4, a valence analogue of a known topological catalyst PtSn4. We show that PtPb4 is a topological semimetal with non-trivial ℤ2 indices under spin-orbit coupling. This nontrivial band topology originates from a band inversion between two Pb-derived states near the Fermi level. Surface calculations reveal well-defined TSSs on the (100) surface, a surface that also exhibits potential HER properties. Hydrogen binding is primarily achieved by the deep H-1s/Pt-d bonding state located well below the Fermi level, while the TSSs play only a secondary, perturbative role in adsorption. By continuously tracking the evolution of the surface bands during adsorption, we demonstrate that the topological order is preserved despite substantial energy shifts, charge transfer, and hybridization in surface states. Our work provides a qualitative picture of how the TSSs of PtPb4 respond to hydrogen adsorption while the global topology of the surface remains inherently robust.

title: CNS localization drives a profoundly immunosuppressive microenvironment in B‑cell lymphoma
abstractText: Abstract Primary central nervous system lymphoma (PCNSL) has significantly poorer outcomes than peripheral diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, suggesting need for novel therapies and a deeper understanding of the unique tumor immune microenvironment (TIME) within the brain. To investigate these CNS‑specific immune features, we established an orthotopic syngeneic murine PCNSL model using intracranial injection of A20 B‑cell lymphoma cells. This model showed reliable engraftment and recapitulated key pathological features of PCNSL. Compared with subcutaneous tumors, intracranial tumor‑draining lymph nodes displayed marked immunosuppression, including reduced memory CD8⁺ T-cells, impaired cytotoxicity, increased regulatory T-cells, and altered dendritic‑cell composition with expanded DC2 populations and elevated CD200 and PD‑L1. The tumor microenvironment exhibited even more pronounced dysfunction, with heightened T‑cell exhaustion and diminished CD4⁺ T‑cell activation. These findings indicate that CNS localization imposes a strongly tolerogenic immune milieu that may contribute to the inferior therapeutic responses observed in PCNSL.

title: Causas y factores de riesgo del embarazo ectópico: revisión narrativa
abstractText: Objetivo: analizar los principales factores de riesgo del embarazo ectópico y sus implicaciones para el diagnóstico y el manejo. Método: revisión narrativa de literatura indexada en PubMed y SciELO; se seleccionaron 15 documentos: estudios de casos y controles, cohortes, series de casos latinoamericanas, revisiones, una guía clínica y dos ensayos aleatorizados. Resultados: el embarazo ectópico afecta al 1 % o 2 % de los embarazos y causa entre el 5 % y el 10 % de las muertes relacionadas con el embarazo. Los factores con mayor asociación fueron el embarazo ectópico previo, la enfermedad inflamatoria pélvica, la infección por Chlamydia trachomatis, el tabaquismo intenso, la gestación con dispositivo intrauterino y las técnicas de reproducción asistida. Conclusión: la mayoría de los factores de riesgo son prevenibles o identificables; su reconocimiento, junto con la ecografía transvaginal y la gonadotropina coriónica seriada, permite un diagnóstico temprano y un tratamiento conservador.

title: Trading privacy for personalisation: Ethical trust and high school students’ intention to use AI in education
abstractText: Educational AI tools personalise learning by drawing on sensitive student data, yet the privacy calculus assumes that people can freely weigh benefits against risks and decline when risks dominate. This assumption is doubtful for adolescents, who have limited ability to scrutinise institutional data practices and little scope to opt out when AI is embedded in schooling. This study examines how perceived personalisation benefits, perceived data sensitivity and privacy concerns relate to high school students’ intention to use AI, and tests whether ethical trust, defined as confidence that an AI system will handle personal data responsibly, transparently and in the user’s interest, links privacy concerns to intention. Survey data from 323 students across IB, A Level, CBSE, American and other curriculums were analysed using partial least squares structural equation modelling. Perceived benefits strongly predicted ethical trust (β = .605, p < .001) and intention to use AI directly (β = .454, p < .001). Perceived data sensitivity raised privacy concerns (β = .563, p < .001), and privacy concerns modestly reduced ethical trust (β of negative .185, p = .002). Ethical trust in turn predicted intention to use AI (β = .453, p < .001), whereas the direct effect of privacy concerns on intention was negligible (β = .023, p = .507). The model explained 65.9% of the variance in intention. The pattern indicates that privacy concern shapes adoption through eroded trust rather than through avoidance, and that usefulness can build trust without proof of trustworthy data practices. Limitations include the cross sectional design, self reported intentions and weaker measurement of data sensitivity. Schools and providers should therefore demonstrate responsible data governance rather than simply reassure students.

title: CT-referenced end-to-end hyperspectral imaging for spatially resolved moisture content mapping in wood
abstractText: Abstract Spatially resolved moisture content (MC) measurement is important for understanding moisture migration and improving drying control in wood. This study developed a CT-referenced end-to-end near-infrared hyperspectral imaging (NIR-HSI) framework for moisture content mapping in Japanese cypress ( Chamaecyparis obtusa ) during drying. X-ray CT images acquired at different moisture states were calibrated to density values and registered to corresponding oven-dry CT images. A latewood mask-based deformable registration method was introduced to compensate for drying-induced deformation, enabling voxel-wise MC calculation. The resulting CT-derived moisture maps were averaged along the thickness direction and screened for reliability, yielding 163 valid paired datasets for partial least squares (PLS) baseline and U-Net model development and evaluation. A conventional PLS regression model was established as a baseline, and a U-Net model was trained to directly predict MC maps from NIR-HSI data. The proposed CT registration method substantially improved image correspondence, increasing the mean Dice similarity coefficient of latewood masks from 0.536 to 0.964. The CT-derived mean MC showed excellent agreement with gravimetric measurements, with an R 2 of 0.9958 and a root mean square error (RMSE) of 3.8729%. Compared with PLS, the end-to-end U-Net model produced more accurate and spatially consistent moisture maps. On the test set, the U-Net reduced the pixel-wise RMSE from 57.71 to 20.87% and increased R 2 , the structural similarity index measure (SSIM), and Pearson’s correlation coefficient from 0.411, 0.6318, and 0.670 to 0.923, 0.9067, and 0.962, respectively. After averaging the predicted maps and comparing them with gravimetric MC, the U-Net also achieved accurate image-level mean-MC prediction on the independent test set, with R 2 = 0.9755, RMSE = 8.5629%, and a ratio of performance to deviation (RPD) of 6.56. Wavelength importance analysis indicated that both PLS and U-Net relied strongly on the water-related absorption region around 960–970 nm. These results demonstrate that combining CT-derived spatial reference data with end-to-end NIR-HSI modeling enables accurate, non-destructive, and spatially resolved moisture content estimation in wood.

title: Salud ginecológica en personas transgénero: ética médica e inclusión
abstractText: Objetivo: describir las necesidades de salud ginecológica de las personas transgénero, en particular el cribado de cáncer, la anticoncepción y la preservación de la fertilidad, desde una perspectiva ética e inclusiva. Método: revisión narrativa de literatura indexada en PubMed y SciELO; se seleccionaron 15 documentos: guías, revisiones, estudios cuantitativos y estudios cualitativos latinoamericanos. Resultados: la prevalencia de VIH en mujeres trans fue del 19,1 % a nivel mundial y del 22,6 % en tres ciudades de Colombia. En hombres trans, el 10,8 % de las citologías fue insatisfactoria, frente al 1,3 % en mujeres cisgénero, y el 61 % de quienes se embarazaron había usado testosterona. Los estudios en Brasil y Argentina describen falta de respeto al nombre social, demoras y escasez de especialistas. Conclusión: la atención ginecológica debe basarse en los órganos presentes, ofrecer anticoncepción y preservación de la fertilidad y eliminar las barreras discriminatorias.

Pengaruh Pemasaran Digital dan Kemudahan Penggunaan Platform Marketplace Shopee Terhadap Minat Beli Mahasiswa Bisnis Digital di Institut Ilmu Hukum dan Ekonomi Lamaddukelleng
abstractText: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis pengaruh pemasaran digital dan kemudahan penggunaan platform marketplace Shopee terhadap minat beli mahasiswa Bisnis Digital di Institut Ilmu Hukum dan Ekonomi Lamaddukelleng, baik secara parsial maupun simultan. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan melibatkan 71 mahasiswa pengguna Shopee sebagai responden. Data penelitian dianalisis menggunakan regresi linear berganda, disertai pengujian hipotesis melalui uji t dan uji F. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa pemasaran digital berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap minat beli mahasiswa, dengan koefisien regresi sebesar 0,290 dan nilai signifikansi 0,004. Kemudahan penggunaan platform juga menunjukkan pengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap minat beli, dengan koefisien regresi sebesar 0,399 dan nilai signifikansi di bawah 0,001. Secara simultan, pemasaran digital dan kemudahan penggunaan platform berpengaruh signifikan terhadap minat beli, yang ditunjukkan oleh nilai F sebesar 15,684 dengan signifikansi di bawah 0,001. Nilai koefisien determinasi (R²) sebesar 0,316 menunjukkan bahwa kedua variabel tersebut mampu menjelaskan 31,6% variasi minat beli mahasiswa, sedangkan 68,4% sisanya berkaitan dengan faktor lain di luar model penelitian. Berdasarkan nilai koefisien beta terstandar, kemudahan penggunaan platform memiliki kontribusi relatif lebih besar dibandingkan pemasaran digital. Penelitian ini menyimpulkan bahwa strategi pemasaran digital yang efektif dan kemudahan penggunaan platform merupakan aspek penting dalam meningkatkan minat beli mahasiswa pada marketplace Shopee.

Pengaruh Attention Economy Terhadap Intensitas Konsumsi Konten Digital dan Perilaku Konsumtif Mahasiswa Gen Z di Institut Lamaddukelleng
abstractText: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis pengaruh Attention Economy terhadap intensitas konsumsi konten digital dan perilaku konsumtif mahasiswa Generasi Z di Institut Lamaddukelleng. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan melibatkan 83 mahasiswa Generasi Z sebagai responden. Data dikumpulkan melalui kuesioner berskala Likert dan dianalisis menggunakan SPSS versi 25 dengan teknik regresi linier sederhana dan regresi linier berganda. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa Attention Economy berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap intensitas konsumsi konten digital, dengan koefisien regresi sebesar 0,656 dan nilai signifikansi di bawah 0,001. Selain itu, Attention Economy berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap perilaku konsumtif dalam pengujian regresi sederhana, dengan koefisien regresi sebesar 0,553 dan nilai signifikansi di bawah 0,001. Intensitas konsumsi konten digital juga menunjukkan pengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap perilaku konsumtif ketika diuji secara terpisah, dengan koefisien regresi sebesar 0,694 dan nilai signifikansi di bawah 0,001. Namun, dalam regresi linier berganda, Attention Economy tetap berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap perilaku konsumtif, sedangkan intensitas konsumsi konten digital tidak menunjukkan pengaruh parsial yang signifikan. Secara simultan, kedua variabel berpengaruh signifikan terhadap perilaku konsumtif, dengan nilai F sebesar 36,621 dan koefisien determinasi (R²) sebesar 0,478. Artinya, kedua variabel mampu menjelaskan 47,8% variasi perilaku konsumtif mahasiswa. Penelitian ini menyimpulkan bahwa Attention Economy merupakan faktor penting yang berkaitan dengan intensitas konsumsi konten digital dan perilaku konsumtif mahasiswa Generasi Z. Temuan ini menegaskan pentingnya kesadaran digital dan pengendalian konsumsi agar mahasiswa lebih kritis dalam merespons konten serta stimulus konsumsi di platform digital.

title: Factores que influyen en la aceptación del tratamiento endodóntico según la edad
abstractText: Objetivo: analizar la evidencia sobre los factores que influyen en la aceptación del tratamiento endodóntico y su relación con la edad del paciente. Métodos: revisión de la literatura con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO; se seleccionaron 15 documentos. Resultados: en Nigeria, el 58,6 % de los pacientes con exposición pulpar eligió la extracción, sobre todo por el costo, el tiempo de tratamiento y experiencias previas desagradables. La ansiedad previa a la endodoncia disminuye un 30 % después del procedimiento, y el dolor se reduce a niveles mínimos en siete días. La edad no mostró una asociación consistente con la elección del tratamiento, mientras que en los adultos mayores pesan las condiciones sistémicas y la complejidad clínica. Conclusión: la aceptación de la endodoncia depende más del costo, el miedo y la información que de la edad.

title: Sustainable development of multifunctional epoxy composites reinforced with jujube seed particles
abstractText: Abstract This study investigates the multi-functional performance of epoxy composites reinforced with Indian wild jujube ( Ziziphus mauritiana ) seed particles as a sustainable and low-cost reinforcement. Composites were fabricated by hand layup with particle concentrations of 4, 8, 12, 16, and 20 wt% in an LY-556 epoxy matrix cured with HY-951 at room temperature. Mechanical, tribological, water absorption, and thermal properties were evaluated, and scanning electron microscopy was used to relate performance to morphology and interfacial behaviour. Particle size analysis showed a bimodal distribution with an average hydrodynamic diameter of 1099 nm and a polydispersity index of 0.969. The composite with 12 wt% particles showed the highest tensile strength of 43.5 MPa, which is a 14.5% improvement over pure epoxy at 38.0 MPa. The maximum flexural strength of 148.7 MPa was obtained at 8 wt% with a 7.5% improvement. Water absorption increased with filler content under both conditions, while saltwater absorption remained lower due to ion-retarded diffusion. Erosion resistance improved for all composites, with the lowest erosion rate of 1.59 mg/min at 20 wt% compared to 1.74 mg/min for pure epoxy. The lowest wear rate of 7.560 × 10⁻⁶ mm³/(Nm) was observed at 4 wt%, after which wear increased with filler content. Thermal analysis showed slower degradation and higher char residue above 450 °C with increasing particle content. This study provides one of the first comprehensive evaluations of epoxy composites reinforced solely with jujube seed particles across mechanical, tribological, and thermal domains. The utilisation of agricultural jujube seed waste as reinforcement supports circular economy principles and contributes to SDG 9 (Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure), SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production), and SDG 13 (Climate Action). Furthermore, the valorisation of agricultural waste into engineering reinforcements promotes resource efficiency and supports the development of sustainable composite materials for advanced engineering applications.

title: Legal Regulation of Homoeopathy in India: A Critical Analysis of the National Commission for Homoeopathy Act, 2020
abstractText: Homoeopathy is one of the most widely practised systems of traditional medicine in India and plays an important role within the AYUSH healthcare framework. The enactment of the National Commission for Homoeopathy Act, 2020 marked a significant shift from the earlier regulatory regime under the Homoeopathy Central Council Act, 1973 by introducing a governance model focused on transparency, accountability, quality medical education and professional ethics. India currently has more than three lakh registered homoeopathic practitioners and hundreds of recognised teaching institutions, which highlights the need for an effective and uniform regulatory framework. This paper critically examines the legal framework established under the National Commission for Homoeopathy Act, 2020, analyses its institutional mechanisms governing education, registration, ethics and professional standards, and evaluates the reforms introduced to strengthen homoeopathic regulation in India. The study adopts a doctrinal research methodology based on an analytical examination of the National Commission for Homoeopathy Act, 2020, relevant rules and regulations, constitutional provisions, parliamentary materials, judicial decisions, government reports and scholarly literature. The paper analyses the evolution of homoeopathy regulation in India, the establishment and functions of the National Commission, the role of its Autonomous Boards, national examinations, practitioner registration, recognition of qualifications, and the regulatory mechanisms designed to improve educational standards and ethical medical practice. The study finds that the Act modernises homoeopathic governance by introducing competency-based education, transparent institutional assessment, digital registration and strengthened ethical oversight. However, challenges relating to implementation, coordination with State Medical Councils, infrastructure disparities and effective enforcement continue to affect its practical effectiveness. The National Commission for Homoeopathy Act, 2020 represents a progressive legislative reform that seeks to balance professional autonomy with public accountability. Its long-term success will depend upon consistent implementation, institutional capacity building, periodic regulatory review and stronger integration of quality assurance mechanisms to ensure accessible, ethical and patient-centred homoeopathic healthcare in India.

title: ANALISIS ENTREPRENEURIAL MINDSET SISWA SEKOLAH MENENGAH KEJURUAN BERDASARKAN KARAKTERISTIK DEMOGRAFIS, PENGALAMAN KEWIRAUSAHAAN, DAN ORIENTASI KARIER
abstractText: ABSTRAK Entrepreneurial mindset merupakan aspek penting bagi siswa Sekolah Menengah Kejuruan (SMK) dalam mengenali peluang kewirausahaan dan menentukan arah karier setelah lulus. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis entrepreneurial mindset siswa berdasarkan karakteristik demografis, pengalaman kewirausahaan, dan orientasi karier. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan desain cross-sectional yang melibatkan 275 siswa kelas XI SMK Saraswati Kota Salatiga. Data dikumpulkan menggunakan kuesioner yang mengukur entrepreneurial mindset dan dianalisis menggunakan korelasi Pearson serta regresi linier berganda. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa entrepreneurial mindset, elaborating mindset, dan implementing mindset siswa berada pada kategori sedang. Karakteristik demografis menunjukkan hubungan yang beragam. Jurusan dan pekerjaan ayah/wali laki-laki memiliki hubungan atau kontribusi signifikan pada beberapa aspek entrepreneurial mindset, sedangkan usia, jenis kelamin, status kewirausahaan orang tua, dan pekerjaan ibu/wali perempuan tidak menunjukkan hubungan yang signifikan. Pengalaman mengikuti pelatihan kewirausahaan berkorelasi positif dengan entrepreneurial mindset dan kedua dimensinya, sedangkan pengalaman menjalankan usaha menunjukkan hubungan yang lebih kuat serta berkontribusi positif dan signifikan terhadap entrepreneurial mindset, elaborating mindset, dan implementing mindset. Orientasi karier juga menunjukkan hubungan yang berbeda berdasarkan pilihan karier, dengan hubungan positif pada orientasi kuliah sambil berwirausaha dan berwirausaha. Temuan ini menunjukkan bahwa entrepreneurial mindset siswa lebih berkaitan dengan pengalaman kewirausahaan dan orientasi karier dibandingkan karakteristik demografis. Leaning left: how turn bias and habitat complexity shape spatial cognition in a coral-reef fish
abstractText: Abstract In coral reef ecosystems, anthropogenic change is rapidly altering habitat structure, but the consequences for fish cognition remain poorly understood. We tested whether structural habitat complexity influences spatial learning and strategy use in the humbug damselfish ( Dascyllus aruanus ). Juveniles were reared in aquaria containing either high- or low-complexity coral structures and trained in a T-maze task, requiring the use of egocentric (turn-based) and/or allocentric (landmark-based) strategies to locate a reward. Performance was assessed using the number of trials to reach a learning criterion and latency to make correct decisions. Probe trials with conflicting cues assessed navigation strategies. Turn direction was the strongest predictor of performance. Fish trained to turn left reached criterion in fewer trials and consistently relied on egocentric strategies, indicative of a lateralisation bias. In contrast, right-turning fish increasingly relied on landmark cues during probe trials and made faster decisions when doing so, suggesting that allocentric strategies reduced the cost of acting against intrinsic turn biases. Contrary to our expectation, environmental complexity did not affect the number of trials required to reach criterion. However, high-complexity fish located the reward faster during early training and showed longer decision latencies during probe trials, suggesting greater sensitivity to landmark information when cues conflicted. Our results suggest that spatial task performance may be shaped more by turn biases and strategy use than by environmental complexity alone, highlighting the importance of considering intrinsic behavioural constraints when interpreting spatial cognition.

title: Depression, anxiety, stress and coping strategies among undergraduates in a public and a private university in Osun State Nigeria using a comparative cross-sectional design
abstractText: Abstract This study compared depression, anxiety and stress symptoms and examined their associated factors among undergraduates in a public university and private university in Osun State, Nigeria. A comparative cross-sectional design was used. Of 387 questionnaires distributed, 340 were returned (87.9%), while 322 sufficiently completed questionnaires were analysed, comprising 161 students from each institution. Data were collected using the Depression, Anxiety and Stress Scale-21 and an adapted 15-item Brief COPE questionnaire. Data were analysed using descriptive statistics, chi-square/Fisher–Freeman–Halton tests, Spearman correlation with Benjamini-Hochberg correction, and pooled binary logistic regression. Moderate-or-higher depression occurred among 19.3% of public and 36.0% of private university students. Depression severity differed significantly between institutions, χ² (4) = 19.60, p<0.001, while private university students had higher adjusted odds of depression (AOR = 1.94, 95% CI: 1.08–3.50). Moderate-or-higher anxiety occurred in 49.7% of students in both institutions, with no significant institutional difference (p = 0.298). Moderate-or-higher stress occurred among 9.9% and 19.3%, respectively, with no significant severity difference (p = 0.106). Denial and Self-Critical Disengagement Coping was positively associated with depression, anxiety and stress in both institutions. Academic dissatisfaction was associated with depression and anxiety, while previous course failure was associated with anxiety. The study concludes that depression showed the clearest institutional difference, while coping and academic experiences were important correlates of psychological symptoms. Universities should strengthen accessible mental-health services, academic support and coping-skills interventions for undergraduate students.

Anticonceptivos reversibles de larga duración y bienestar de las mujeres: revisión narrativa
abstractText: Objetivo: analizar la eficacia, la continuidad, la seguridad y los efectos sociales de los anticonceptivos reversibles de larga duración (ARLD), con referencia al contexto ecuatoriano. Método: revisión narrativa de literatura indexada en PubMed y SciELO; se seleccionaron 15 documentos: cohortes, ensayos, revisiones, una guía y análisis poblacionales, uno de ellos con la ENSANUT 2018 del Ecuador. Resultados: la tasa de falla de los ARLD fue de 0,27 por 100 años-participante, frente a 4,55 con píldora, parche o anillo, y su continuidad a 12 meses fue del 86 %, frente al 55 % con píldora. El acceso gratuito redujo el embarazo adolescente y los nacimientos en mujeres jóvenes de bajos ingresos. El efecto adverso más frecuente del implante fue el cambio del patrón de sangrado. Conclusión: los ARLD son los métodos reversibles más eficaces; su beneficio social depende de la consejería, la gratuidad y la eliminación de barreras de acceso.

title: Multiobjective optimization of foamed concrete for sustainable construction using statistical and artificial intelligence approaches
abstractText: Abstract Foamed concrete is lightweight and insulating, but its mix design is a headache. Strength, durability, and carbon footprint all fight each other. This review looks at how researchers have tried to optimize these trade-offs using methods like RSM, Taguchi, ANN, and genetic algorithms. RSM is easy to interpret but struggles with nonlinear foam behavior. AI models handle nonlinearity better but need lots of data and tell you nothing about why they work. The best path forward seems to be hybrid approaches. On the environmental side, cement drives most of the carbon. Replacing it with SCMs can cut GWP by 20–50%. We put together a conceptual Pareto front showing the sweet spot: 900–1200 kg/m³ density, 8–15 MPa strength, and 350–500 kg CO₂-eq/m³. Big gaps remain. No standard testing protocols. Pore-scale physics is missing from models. Almost nobody has coupled LCA with real optimization. Field validation is rare. We end with a research roadmap: hybrid frameworks, open databases, and proper microstructural inputs.

title: Disilicato de litio y zirconio en la rehabilitación oral estética y funcional
abstractText: Objetivo: analizar la evidencia sobre el comportamiento clínico del disilicato de litio y del zirconio en la rehabilitación oral estética y funcional. Métodos: revisión de la literatura indexada en PubMed y SciELO; se seleccionaron 15 documentos: revisiones sistemáticas, estudios clínicos retrospectivos y prospectivos, estudios de laboratorio y revisiones narrativas. Resultados: en 87 203 restauraciones de disilicato de litio, la supervivencia a cinco años fue del 98,6 % en las carillas, del 89,5 % en las coronas y del 52,9 % en las prótesis parciales fijas. La supervivencia a cinco años de las coronas fue del 96,6 % con cerámicas vítreas reforzadas y del 92,1 % con zirconio, y la de coronas monolíticas de zirconio, del 98 %. El zirconio mostró mayor resistencia a la fractura. Conclusión: el disilicato de litio es preferible en el sector anterior y el zirconio en las zonas de alta carga oclusal.

title: Jerarquía de la evidencia científica en odontología
abstractText: Objetivo: describir los niveles de la jerarquía de la evidencia científica en odontología y sus implicaciones para la toma de decisiones clínicas. Métodos: revisión de la literatura con síntesis narrativa en PubMed, SciELO y la Biblioteca Cochrane; se seleccionaron 15 documentos metodológicos y revisiones sistemáticas odontológicas. Resultados: las revisiones sistemáticas con metaanálisis y los ensayos controlados aleatorizados ocupan los niveles superiores; les siguen los estudios de cohortes, los de casos y controles, los reportes de caso, la opinión de expertos y los estudios in vitro. Ejemplos odontológicos muestran que una revisión de 38 ensayos sobre selladores y otra de 51 estudios sobre clorhexidina aportan certeza moderada o alta, mientras que los diseños inferiores generan hipótesis. Conclusión: la jerarquía orienta, pero no sustituye, la evaluación crítica de cada estudio; su aplicación debe integrar la certeza de la evidencia, la experiencia clínica y las preferencias del paciente.

title: Data-driven clinical phenotypes of diabetic kidney disease and their association with disease progression: a real-world cohort study
DARI BUKU MENUJU PENGALAMAN BELAJAR MENDALAM: ANALISIS KUALITAS BUKU MATEMATIKA KELAS V BERPERSPEKTIF ACTIVE DEEP LEARNER EXPERIENCE (ADLX)
abstractText: Pendekatan Active Deep Learner eXperience (ADLX) telah diterapkan dalam pembelajaran, namun kajian terhadap kualitas buku ajar sebagai pendukung implementasinya masih terbatas. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis kualitas Buku Matematika Kelas V JSIT Indonesia pada materi bilangan dalam mendukung ADLX. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan deskriptif kualitatif dengan metode analisis isi (content analysis). Buku dianalisis berdasarkan aspek kelayakan isi, penyajian, bahasa, dan kegrafikan yang selanjutnya diinterpretasikan melalui komponen Active Learning, Deep Learning, dan Learner eXperience. Hasil menunjukkan bahwa buku memiliki kualitas yang baik dalam mendukung ketiga komponen ADLX. Kelayakan isi mendukung Deep Learning melalui kesesuaian materi dengan capaian pembelajaran, pengembangan konsep secara bertahap, dan penerapan konsep dalam konteks kehidupan nyata. Kelayakan penyajian memfasilitasi Active Learning melalui eksplorasi, diskusi, presentasi, dan pemecahan masalah, sedangkan penggunaan bahasa yang komunikatif mendukung keterlibatan dan pemahaman konsep. Kegrafikan melalui ilustrasi, tata letak, dan keterbacaan turut mendukung Learner eXperience. Namun, aktivitas pembelajaran masih cenderung terstruktur, soal terbuka dan investigasi mandiri masih terbatas, serta konteks lokal belum dimanfaatkan secara optimal. Dengan demikian, buku berpotensi mendukung implementasi ADLX, tetapi masih memerlukan penguatan aktivitas eksploratif, investigatif, dan pemanfaatan konteks lokal.

Serum FGF-21 levels and stature in children and adolescents with celiac disease on a gluten-free diet
abstractText: Abstract Objectives To evaluate stature in patients with celiac disease (CD) adherent to a gluten-free diet (GFD), determine the prevalence of growth hormone deficiency (GHD), and assess the associations between stature and serum insulin-like growth factor-1 (IGF-1), insulin-like growth factor–binding protein 3 (IGFBP-3), and FGF 21 levels. Methods In this prospective cross-sectional study, 141 pediatric patients with CD (79 females) who had adhered to a GFD for at least 2 years were included. Anthropometric and clinical data were obtained from medical records. Serum IGF-1, IGFBP-3, and FGF21 levels were measured in fasting samples. Growth hormone stimulation tests (L-dopa and clonidine) were performed in patients with a height >1.5 SDS below target height (TH). Results Twelve patients (8.5 %) had persistent short stature despite long-term adherence to a GFD. Growth hormone deficiency was diagnosed in three patients (2.1 % of the entire cohort; 25 % of patients with persistent short stature). Patients with persistent short stature without GHD had significantly lower serum IGF-1 and IGFBP-3 standard deviation scores than those with normal stature, whereas serum FGF21 concentrations did not differ significantly between the groups. Serum FGF21 concentrations were not significantly correlated with height SDS, IGF-1, IGFBP-3, or other anthropometric variables. Conclusions Persistent short stature may occur despite long-term adherence to a GFD in a small proportion of children and adolescents with CD. GHD was identified in 2.1 % of patients, emphasizing the importance of growth monitoring. Lower IGF-1 and IGFBP-3 SDS in patients with persistent short stature without GHD suggest alterations within the GH–IGF axis. Serum FGF21 concentrations were not associated with stature, suggesting that persistent growth impairment in treated CD is likely multifactorial and is not explained by circulating FGF21 alone.

title: Diabetes mellitus y su impacto en la implantología dental
abstractText: Objetivo: analizar la evidencia sobre el impacto de la diabetes mellitus en la supervivencia de los implantes dentales y en las enfermedades periimplantarias. Métodos: revisión de la literatura con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO; se seleccionaron 15 documentos. Resultados: un metaanálisis de 89 publicaciones estimó una probabilidad de fracaso un 77,7 % mayor en pacientes diabéticos (OR 1,777) y una pérdida ósea marginal 0,776 mm mayor. Una revisión previa, con 14 estudios, no halló diferencias en el fracaso. La supervivencia a corto plazo fue del 96,4 % al 100 %, y el mal control glucémico retrasó la estabilización del implante. La hiperglucemia, en especial con HbA1c mayor de 8 %, se asoció con más enfermedad periimplantaria. Conclusión: los implantes son una opción segura en pacientes diabéticos con buen control glucémico, siempre que se apliquen medidas preventivas y un mantenimiento periimplantario regular.

title: Evaluating the biorational profile of selected insecticides in Spodoptera littoralis: from nutritional disruption and genotoxicity to in silico risk analysis
abstractText: Abstract Background Spodoptera littoralis is a highly destructive pest that threatens various economically important crops. This study evaluated the sublethal effects of five insecticides (Chlorantraniliprole, thiacloprid, emamectin benzoate, indoxacarb, and Bacillus thuringiensis ) on the nutritional indices and growth of 3rd and 5th instar larvae using leaf-dip bioassays at LC 10 and LC 50 concentrations. The food conversion efficiency and larval growth rate were analyzed. The safety of the selected insecticides was determined using genotoxicity assay. In silico analysis; a Computational modeling to predict off-target safety and ecological risk, offers a holistic understanding of both the efficacy and safety profiles of insecticides application. Results The results revealed significant sub-lethal effects on feeding and growth. B. thuringiensis exhibited the highest feeding deterrence index (FDI) to more than 50% for 5th instar larvae. Conversely, Coragen and Indoxacarb showed moderate FDI effects. Thiacloprid at LC 50 caused the greatest reduction in the efficiency of conversion of ingested food (ECI). The relative growth rate variably changed across all treatments, values were negative for most treatments, indicating growth inhibition, with Thiacloprid causing the greatest reduction. Impaired food conversion efficiency was detected across treatments, particularly for Thiacloprid and Coragen. Approximate Digestibility (AD) remained high across treatments, with Coragen (99.393%) and B. thuringiensis (99.276%) showing the highest AD values. The comparative genotoxicity analysis through the comet assay revealed that the maximum DNA damage occurred after feeding on Thiacloprid-treated plant leaves, corresponding to a type II effect (25–45% damage). Meanwhile, the bacterial treatment revealed a type I effect corresponding to 0–25% damage. Toxicity studies were supported by in silico physico-chemical properties and toxicity profile. The immunotoxicity, respiratory, oral and dermal toxicity, potential hepatotoxicity and aquatic toxicity were the primary hazards of emamectin benzoate identified in silico. Conversely, it was anticipated that mutagenicity, skin sensitisation and irritation and inhalation toxicity would be low. Conclusion The findings emphasise that microbial insecticides such as B. thuringiensis are effective feeding deterrents with moderate sublethal effects on food utilisation, whereas chemical insecticides such as Thiacloprid and Coragen significantly disrupt growth and nutrient assimilation. These results provide critical insights into the use of insecticides in integrated pest management programs for S. littoralis .

title: Férula Michigan en el tratamiento de los trastornos temporomandibulares
abstractText: Objetivo: analizar la evidencia sobre la eficacia de la férula Michigan o de estabilización en el tratamiento de los trastornos temporomandibulares. Métodos: revisión de la literatura indexada en PubMed y SciELO; se seleccionaron 15 documentos: metaanálisis, revisiones sistemáticas, criterios diagnósticos, consensos y estudios clínicos. Resultados: los trastornos temporomandibulares afectan al 34 % de la población mundial y al 47 % en América del Sur. En el corto plazo, la férula de estabilización redujo la intensidad del dolor (diferencia de medias estandarizada −0,33), con mejores resultados en los trastornos de origen muscular, pero sin diferencias a largo plazo. La revisión Cochrane de 57 ensayos calificó la certeza de la evidencia como muy baja, y la evidencia sobre el bruxismo es insuficiente. Conclusión: la férula Michigan es una opción reversible y conservadora con un beneficio modesto y a corto plazo, que debe integrarse en un tratamiento multimodal.

From perception to practice: Faculty-led assessment redesign in response to generative AI in higher education
abstractText: The rapid diffusion of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) tools such as ChatGPT into higher education has unsettled long standing assumptions about the validity, reliability, and authenticity of conventional assessment methods. Existing research has predominantly examined perceptions, ethical concerns, and technology acceptance, leaving the actual pedagogical redesign work of faculty, and its relationship to established principles of assessment quality, comparatively underexplored. Drawing on constructive alignment theory, this study examines how faculty are reshaping assessment design under conditions of AI disruption and whether their adaptation strategies address or fail to address core dimensions of assessment validity. A sequential explanatory mixed methods design was used across two phases: a survey of 180 faculty members across STEM and non STEM disciplines at a private institution in India, followed by semi structured interviews and assessment artefact analysis with a purposively selected subset of participants. The results show a marked shift away from unsupervised, product based assessment toward process oriented, reflective, and authentic formats, including oral examinations, project based tasks, in class problem solving, and reflective journals, an implicit faculty led re alignment of assessment with intended learning outcomes. Faculty frame GenAI simultaneously as a threat to assessment integrity and as a catalyst for pedagogical innovation, but institutional structures have not kept pace with this bottom up change, and increased workload, inconsistent guidance, and limited professional development persist as barriers to sustaining and scaling redesign. By empirically documenting faculty led transformation and connecting it explicitly to theories of assessment quality and institutional change, the study moves beyond descriptive accounts of GenAI's impact and offers practical guidance for educators, instructional designers, and institutional leaders seeking to formalise sustainable, valid, and equitable assessment redesign in the GenAI era.

The Relationship Between Family Support and Hypertension Prevention Behavior In Adolescents
abstractText: Hypertension in adolescents is increasing due to the low adoption of healthy lifestyle behaviors, so family support is an important factor in forming preventive behaviors. This study aims to analyze the relationship between family support and hypertension prevention behaviors in adolescents at SMP Negeri 8 Palangka Raya City. This study used a quantitative correlational design with a cross-sectional approach. The accessible population was 377 eighth-grade students, with a sample of 66 respondents selected using quota sampling techniques. The research instruments were a family support questionnaire and a hypertension prevention behavior questionnaire that had been tested for validity and reliability. Data were analyzed using univariate analysis and the Spearman Rank correlation test with a significance level of 0.05. The results showed that 92% of respondents had good family support and 92% had good hypertension prevention behaviors. The Spearman Rank test showed a significant positive relationship between family support and hypertension prevention behaviors (p = 0.007; r = 0.331). In conclusion, family support is significantly related to hypertension prevention behaviors in adolescents, so family involvement needs to be optimized in health promotion programs to develop healthy lifestyle behaviors from an early age.

title: Dynamic Diels–Alder-Crosslinked Zwitterionic Polyurethane Coatings with Self-Healing, Antibacterial, and Antifouling Properties
abstractText: Abstract Coatings used in marine and humid environments are simultaneously exposed to biofouling and mechanical damage, which progressively compromise their interfacial functionality and service stability. In this study, polyurethane resins bearing terminal maleimide groups and sulfobetaine moieties (ZPU-X) were synthesized and subsequently crosslinked with a tetrafunctional furan-terminated compound (TF) through reversible Diels–Alder (DA) reactions to produce dynamically DA-crosslinked zwitterionic polyurethane coatings (SA-X). The sulfobetaine groups promoted the formation of hydrated interfaces that reduced microorganism-coating interactions, achieving maximum antibacterial and antialgal rates of 96.7 and 99.7%, respectively, while effectively suppressing surface colonization by Aspergillus niger (A. niger). The reversible furan-maleimide crosslinks endowed the system with the capacity for segmental rearrangement and network reconstruction. After self-healing, the tensile strength and elongation at break of the coatings reached up to 25.69 ± 0.17 MPa and 1645.13 ± 54.27%, respectively. After 1000 Taber abrasion cycles, the coatings retained liquid-repellent behavior, demonstrating good surface functionality under wear. This work provides an effective strategy for developing functional polyurethane coatings that integrate antibacterial, antifouling, and self-healing properties.

abstractText: Kekhawatiran orang tua terhadap degradasi moral anak di tengah pengaruh digital, keterbatasan pengawasan, dan kemampuan pendidikan agama di keluarga mendorong pencarian lembaga pendidikan yang mampu memberikan pembinaan agama dan karakter secara lebih intensif. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis faktor-faktor yang mendorong orang tua memilih Pondok Pesantren Ma’arif Jam’iyatul Islamiyah pada jenjang Madrasah Tsanawiyah kelas VII di Desa Bagik Payung Suralaga serta mengidentifikasi faktor yang paling dominan dalam keputusan tersebut. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode penelitian kualitatif dengan pendekatan kualitatif. Jenis penelitian yang digunakan adalah penelitian lapangan (field research). Teknik pengumpulan data menggunakan observasi, wawancara, dan dokumentasi. Analisis data menggunakan model Miles dan Huberman yang meliputi reduksi data, penyajian data, dan penarikan kesimpulan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa keputusan orang tua dipengaruhi oleh beberapa faktor, yaitu pendidikan agama, pembentukan karakter, lingkungan pergaulan, kepercayaan terhadap lembaga, harapan terhadap masa depan anak, kedekatan lokasi, serta rekomendasi keluarga dan masyarakat. Snæfellsnes—off-axis volcanism in Western Iceland: inferences on mantle lithology and temperature
abstractText: Volcanism in Iceland can be compositionally and spatially divided into two broad groups: tholeiitic basalts erupted from the active rift and smaller degree alkaline, to transitional-tholeiitic basalts erupted in off-axis areas. Investigating the melt generation processes for off-axis volcanism requires constraining parameters including, melt-source material, temperature, and pressure. Here, we utilize trace elements in olivine macrocrysts and Al-in-olivine thermometry to independently constrain melt source lithology, and maximum crystallization temperatures from post-glacial melts on the Snæfellsnes Peninsula. High-precision trace element (Ni, Fe, and Mn) analyses of olivine, from 20 Snæfellsnes lava flows, have similar concentrations to rift olivines, this indicates similar melt source lithologies for Snæfellsnes and rift lavas, most likely peridotite. Al-in-olivine geothermometry data from 17 lava flows from primitive (Fo > 85%) olivine macrocrysts show consistent maximum crystallization temperatures ~1300 °C for Snæfellsnes, lower than the rift zone but higher than MORB.

title: The Relationship Between Approval of Nursing Actions and Patient Satisfaction Levels In The Inpatient Ward of Bougenville 3, Dr. Loekmono Hadi Kudus Regional Hospital
abstractText: Consent for nursing actions is an important part of patient-centered care because it plays a role in improving communication, trust, and patient satisfaction. This study aims to analyze the relationship between consent for nursing actions and patient satisfaction levels in the Inpatient Room of Bougenville 3, Dr. Loekmono Hadi Kudus Regional General Hospital. This study used a quantitative correlation analytic design with a cross-sectional approach. The study population was 53 inpatients, with a sample of 47 respondents selected using a purposive sampling technique. Data were collected using the Quality of Informed Consent (QuIC) instrument and the Patient Satisfaction Questionnaire Short Form (PSQ-18). Data analysis was performed univariately and bivariately using the Spearman Rank correlation test with a significance level of 0.05. The results showed that 63.8% of respondents received consent for nursing actions in the good category and 59.6% had a very satisfied level of satisfaction. The Spearman Rank test showed a significant relationship between consent for nursing actions and patient satisfaction (p = 0.000; r = 0.919), indicating a very strong positive relationship. It was concluded that the implementation of improved nursing action agreements contributed to increasing patient satisfaction and therefore needed to be maintained and improved as part of efforts to improve the quality of nursing services.

Hasil uji instrumen menunjukkan bahwa seluruh item pernyataan valid (r-hitung > 0,325) dan reliabel (Cronbach’s Alpha antara 0,771 dan 0,810). Beyond awareness: How perceived benefits, risk and trust shape Indian investors' preference and intention toward green investments
abstractText: Sustainable finance has expanded rapidly in India, yet retail uptake of green investments remains uneven, and little is known about the behavioural factors that shape preference for green over conventional options. This study examines how awareness, perceived benefits, perceived risk and trust influence investment preference, and how that preference translates into behavioural intention to invest in green financial products. Drawing on behavioural finance and ESG literature, a structured questionnaire was administered online to a convenience sample of 250 individual investors, and the proposed model was tested using partial least squares structural equation modelling in SmartPLS. The measurement model met reliability and validity criteria, and model fit was acceptable (SRMR of 0.062 for the saturated model and 0.074 for the estimated model). Perceived benefits (β = 0.329) and trust (β = 0.269) increased investment preference, while perceived risk reduced it (β = 0.244, negative). Awareness had no significant direct effect (β = 0.107, p = 0.128). Investment preference strongly predicted behavioural intention (β = 0.624), consistent with a mediating role for preference, and the model explained 40.8% of the variance in preference and 38.7% in intention. The findings indicate that knowing about green investments is not enough, and that perceived value, credible ESG disclosure and lower perceived risk matter more. The study adds evidence from an emerging market to behavioural finance and sustainable investing research and offers guidance for policymakers, financial institutions and ESG practitioners.

abstractText: Abstract Objectives To investigate healthcare professionals’ knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAPs) of the environmental impact and sustainability of iodinated contrast media (ICM). Materials and methods A cross-sectional web-based survey was distributed to members of professional societies and advertised via social media between June and December 2024. The questionnaire covered themes including sustainability attitudes, reduction strategies, waste management, patient awareness, and institutional policies. Data were analysed using descriptive statistics, chi-square tests, and analysis of variance (ANOVA). Results 231 respondents from 44 countries completed the survey, primarily diagnostic radiographers (59%) and radiologists (38%). Most respondents (60%) reported that their institutions had sustainable ICM policies, and there was a significant association between institutional size and alignment with sustainability goals $$\left({X}^{2}=14.2,{p}=0.003\right)$$ X 2 = 14.2 , p = 0.003 . Adoption of reduction strategies such as protocol optimisation, saline chasers, and multi-patient systems varied significantly across institutions $$\left({X}^{2}=18.5,{p}=0.001\right)$$ X 2 = 18.5 , p = 0.001 , with younger professionals (25–44 years) more engaged $$\left({ANOVA},{F}=5.62,{p}=0.001\right)$$ A N O V A , F = 5.62 , p = 0.001 . Respondents reported waste management practices being inconsistently applied, with 26% of respondents reporting “never engaging” $$\left({X}^{2}=19.6,{p} \, < \,0.001\right)$$ X 2 = 19.6 , p < 0.001 . Patient awareness was perceived as low, 47% “strongly disagreeing” that patients understood the environmental impact of ICM use $$\left({X}^{2}=16.9,{p}=0.002\right)$$ X 2 = 16.9 , p = 0.002 . Variability in KAPs across European countries was minimal $$\left({s}^{2}=0.0068\right)$$ s 2 = 0.0068 . Conclusions This survey highlights widespread professional awareness of ICM sustainability issues but reveals variability in institutional practices, limited patient awareness, and inconsistent waste management. Findings emphasise the importance of stronger institutional policies, targeted education, and international collaboration to promote sustainable ICM use.

title: Object groups mutually bias each other’s perceived average size, as evidenced by neural and behavioural data
abstractText: Abstract The human visual system simultaneously computes summary statistics of object features, such as average size, across groups of objects. Evidence suggests that summary statistics across groups of objects (ensembles) are not independent but influence one another. We investigated whether an ensemble’s average size affects the perceived average size of another ensemble, and whether such changes are reflected in altered activation patterns in the visual cortex. Distractor ensembles’ average sizes altered the perceived average size of target ensembles in a contrast-like manner: Large distractor ensembles decreased the target ensembles’ perceived average sizes; conversely, smaller distractor ensembles increased target ensembles’ perceived average sizes. These contrast effects were reflected in more activated voxels in retinotopic regions when target ensembles were perceived as larger. Distractor ensembles’ voxel counts were similarly modulated by target ensembles’ average size, suggesting their perceived average size was also altered. Additionally, individual differences in the magnitude of the ensemble-size contrast effect covaried with activation in higher-level regions, including the left intraparietal sulcus (IPS) and middle temporal gyrus (MTG). Together, these findings suggest that ensemble summary statistics are contrasted, resulting in changes in perceived size and altered retinotopic activation pattern, with involvement of a network including left IPS and left MTG.

title: Predictive performance of clinical, physiological, and trauma scores for life-saving interventions in pediatric trauma: a retrospective cohort study
abstractText: Abstract Background Early identification of pediatric trauma patients requiring life-saving interventions (LSIs) is fundamental for optimizing emergency triage and allocation planning. This study aimed to evaluate and compare the predictive effectiveness of the Abbreviated Injury Scale (AIS), Injury Severity Score (ISS), Pediatric Trauma Score (PTS), Shock Index (SI), and the BIG score for determining LSI requirements in a pediatric emergency trauma population. Methods A retrospective observational study was conducted at the Pediatric Emergency Department of Hacettepe University, a Level I pediatric trauma center, between January 2019 and December 2022. Patients aged 0–18 years presenting within one hour of injury and observed for ≥ 8 h were enrolled. Demographic, clinical, laboratory, and injury scoring data were systematically collected. Multivariable logistic regression analysis was performed to identify independent predictors of LSI requirement. Results A total of 559 patients were included (median age 91.4 months [IQR 35.1–170.2]; 64.6% male), of whom 32.0% ( n = 179) required a life-saving intervention. Because several of the evaluated scores are structurally interdependent, a parsimonious multivariable model was constructed from one representative variable per score family (ISS, PTS, and SI). Higher ISS (adjusted OR 1.145, 95% CI 1.091–1.202) and lower PTS (adjusted OR 0.552, 95% CI 0.474–0.642) were independent predictors of LSI requirement (both p < 0.001), whereas the shock index was not ( p = 0.134). This combined model (ISS + PTS + SI) showed excellent discrimination (AUC 0.961, 95% CI 0.943–0.978) and significantly outperformed the best individual score, the PTS (AUC 0.947; DeLong p = 0.004). Among individual scores, discrimination was highest for the PTS, followed by the GCS (0.920), ISS (0.918), the BIG score (0.897), and AIS (0.878), with the SI (0.601) the lowest. After adjustment for injury severity and neurological status, base deficit—rather than lactate—remained an independent metabolic predictor. Conclusion In pediatric trauma patients, the PTS, GCS, and ISS were the strongest individual predictors of LSI requirement, and a parsimonious model integrating anatomical, integrated physiological, and hemodynamic domains significantly outperformed the best-performing individual score, the PTS (DeLong p = 0.004). In a separate adjusted analysis of the subgroup with complete laboratory data, base deficit—but not lactate—remained an independent metabolic predictor; these metabolic markers were not components of the combined ISS + PTS + SI model, in which the SI itself demonstrated limited discrimination. A multiparametric approach—integrating anatomical, physiological, and hemodynamic domains in the combined model, with metabolic markers evaluated in a separate analysis—may provide a more robust framework for early in-hospital risk stratification after initial diagnostic evaluation.
